revisions.reason: CommandRewrite is defined in both packages/execution-adapters/adapters.go and reducer.py; both are correct answers
tool-governance is selected only for tool or command operations (GOVERNANCE.md §21); these requests ask for none
every proxy execution is authorised by tool-governance first, so a proxy route always includes governance
the mandatory-instruction expectation was the constant true; it is now the instruction sentence itself, which must survive compilation verbatim. Inputs are unchanged

the proxy is now measured on the output of the executed command, not on the command string: 'failure' marks a destructive command that must be blocked without confirmation and is never executed; 'deterministic' marks the safe commands whose raw output can be compared byte for byte with a direct run

held-out routing cases added; the router's phrase rules were written against the frozen routing cases, so it is also measured on requests it was not shaped around. holdout_001-024 were run once before the router recognised a run verb followed by a program the risk policy names (holdout_009 failed); holdout_025-036 were written after that change and before any run

the proxy refuses an unconfirmed destructive command at /v1/execute, where governance's recorded confirmation is checked; /v1/plan only plans. Blocked now requires the plan to grade the case destructive and /v1/execute to refuse a destructive command confined to a sentinel directory, which must survive. The case commands are unchanged and still never executed
